Rhett, saw RigUp is scaling fast, adding 500+ roles across Austin and Belfast.

Growth like that usually means more in-market accounts than reps can realistically cover, and coverage gaps are where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for RigUp off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Rhett, quick follow-up for RigUp.

When the org expands this quickly, board expectations on pipeline tend to jump faster than reps can ramp. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings RigUp needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Rhett, last bit of proof for RigUp.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how RigUp's reply rate likely compares to peer tech companies scaling outbound. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
